research_question: Can decision-directed measurement strategies improve leak-localisation evidence per unit of sensor and inspection effort on a reproducible synthetic EPANET scenario corpus?

notes: The existing W0 input is a small synthetic contract fixture, not a calibrated network.
No hydraulic simulation output is attached.

planned_axes: synthetic leak location and magnitude across declared discrete ranges
nodal demand perturbation and timing profile
held-out parameter combinations for robustness checks
scenario_corpus.random_seed_policy: Freeze and hash one seed manifest before execution; use matched scenario seeds across strategies and a separate held-out seed set.
negative_controls: zero-leak/no-fault must not count as a correctly localised leak
missing or corrupted sensor channels are failed/unavailable, never zero readings
input or scenario digest drift invalidates attached results
duplicated sensor information must not be credited as independent information gain

candidate_actions.question: Which bounded pressure measurements distinguish candidate synthetic leak hypotheses?
candidate_actions.decision_target: Reduce ambiguity between baseline and declared synthetic leak cases without revealing real asset locations.
candidate_actions.expected_evidence_type: Timestamped synthetic node-pressure series with labelled scenarios and stated measurement noise.

assumptions: No sensor prices, installation costs, telemetry costs, sampling intervals or labour rates have been established.
Information gain cannot be inferred from intuition alone.
Estimate it only after labelled scenarios, noise assumptions and a declared hypothesis prior exist.

blocking_unknowns: No scenario corpus or sensor-noise model has been executed.
No field data collection or deployment is authorised.

candidate_actions.question: Does an independent meter-quality check change which synthetic flow observations are trusted?
candidate_actions.decision_target: Distinguish instrumentation error from a simulated physical-loss hypothesis.
candidate_actions.expected_evidence_type: Synthetic calibrated and perturbed meter readings with ground-truth bias and uncertainty labels.

assumptions: No meter calibration or staff-time cost model is available.
No likelihood model for calibration outcomes has been specified.
Information gain and decision value must remain separate quantities.

blocking_unknowns: No ground-truth meter-error distribution is specified.
No real meter telemetry is attached.

candidate_actions.question: Can a primary-document table check resolve an aggregate discrepancy before intervention planning?
candidate_actions.decision_target: Prevent unresolved annual-report KPIs from entering a model as settled facts.
candidate_actions.expected_evidence_type: Reviewed source page/table locator, transcription, reviewer identity and correction history.

assumptions: No task-duration or cost estimate has been measured.
This is a provenance-resolving desk task, not a hydraulic observation.
Do not attribute expected service improvement to resolving a documentation discrepancy.

blocking_unknowns: A reviewer must inspect the primary table before a provisional value is promoted.
Document review alone cannot provide pipe-level hydraulic calibration.

metric_definitions.definition: Fraction of labelled leak scenarios where the true leak class appears within predeclared top-k candidates.
metric_definitions.prohibited_interpretation: Not a field leak detection rate or a performance guarantee.

metric_definitions.definition: Simulated elapsed time from scenario onset to a detection meeting frozen criteria.
metric_definitions.prohibited_interpretation: Not operational response time or a guarantee of reduced outages.

metric_definitions.definition: Sensor channels required by the declared budget convention.
Declared information redundancy across selected channels, with the exact method recorded.
metric_definitions.prohibited_interpretation: Information/entropy reduction is not automatically service or monetary benefit.

metric_definitions.definition: Worst-case top-k localisation outcome on held-out scenarios, preserving denominator and failed cases.
metric_definitions.prohibited_interpretation: Not a guarantee outside the tested scenario domain.

notes: Numerical thresholds have not been chosen and must be justified before any strategy result is examined.
All strategies must use identical scenario manifests and matched seeds.
Report per-scenario failures and uncertainty; do not select a winner from an aggregate scalar score.

comparison_policy.same_seed_policy: Matched scenario seeds across strategies; freeze and hash training and held-out manifests separately.

nonclaims: This is an experiment protocol, not an executed EPANET study.
No expected information gain, financial value, sensor cost or localisation performance has been estimated.
No real network, telemetry, sensor location or fieldwork authorisation is represented.
This protocol does not establish that information-directed strategies outperform any baseline.
Do not claim reproduced results until inputs, solver identity, scenario manifest, outputs and failures are independently reviewed.
